trainingData.value: 12B base pre-trained on 20 trillion tokens (curated and synthetic); post-training ~90B tokens including Safety 2K SFT samples

source.quote:
We create Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 by first pre-training a 12-billion-parameter
                                        model (Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base) on 20 trillion tokens using an FP8 training recipe.

findings.text: Safety appears only as supervised fine-tuning (SFT) training data (~2K samples) built from harmful/benign prompts and filtered with guard models; the report gives no safety benchmark scores for the released models.

source.quote:
Safety. We leveraged a mix of harmful and benign prompts drawn from the Nemotron Content
Safety Dataset V2 (Ghosh et al., 2025)12 , HarmfulTasks (Hasan et al., 2024), RedTeam2K (Luo
et al., 2024), and gretel-v1 (gre, 2024).

findings.text: Without truncation training, the model can stay in thinking mode after a forced </think> closure and may emit another closing tag.

source.quote:
Another issue is that the model can remain in “thinking mode” even after the closing tag
    </think> is inserted.

notes: Technical report (arXiv:2508.14444), not a system card. No risk framework, external safety testers, or safety/alignment/jailbreak/toxicity eval numbers. Safety is only SFT data mix (Table 7 Safety 2K) plus guard-model filtering of training responses—treated as training method, so topics stay uncovered. CC-NEWS through April 23, 2025 used to improve knowledge cutoff but no explicit cutoff date stated. Capability tables skipped per pilot (name in reply): Figure 1 accuracy/throughput; Tables 5–6 base (incl. Global-MMLU-Lite, MGSM); Table 8 (AIME-2024/2025, MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench, SciCode, Humanity's Last Exam, IFEval, BFCL v3, RULER@128k, ArenaHard); RULER long-context ablations; budget-control Figure 5; pruning throughput Table 10. Aligned intermediate Nemotron-Nano-v2-12B (Table 8) is not listed among released Hugging Face checkpoints.
